In addition to that, I felt a little history lesson may be in order since Mountain Dew has quite the history! I will start off with the history of Mountain Dew; Then lead up to how they came up with Amp energy drink. Do a brief discussion as to how Amp energy drink changed over the years. Mountain Dew also decided to try out another energy drink called Kickstart energy. Although they didn't want to compete with Amp, they also wanted to tap into an additional energy drink market. That will then lead us into Game Fuel Amp by Mountain Dew. It's a LOT of logos on one can to try and sell it as best as possible. 

Once the history lesson is over, I will do a full product review on Game Fuel, as well as a taste test. There are currently four different flavors of Game Fuel which include Original Dew, Cherry Burst, Berry Blast and Tropical Strike.
